versionImpact.rationale: This Alpha substantially reframes the product white paper around continuity for long-running agent work while preserving the existing publication and package coordinates.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: The paper now explains why durable Work identity, governed evidence, bounded authority, and continuity across replaceable Agents are necessary for long-running agent work.
The public narrative introduces Project, Work, and Agent together with Agent Work Lab as the product entry point and evidence surface.
The paper presents the Foundation Triad at a first-reader gradient and connects present product continuity to the longer-horizon Machine Life direction.
The PDF gains a commercial editorial system, a real Kungfu CLI evidence view, and a kungfu.tech cover contact while retaining a reproducible pinned Docker build.

summary: Alpha 11 is a minor-impact narrative release that makes continuity for agent work the present product thesis and Machine Life the future direction.
